_nota: Suoni della pagina a voce. Il testo in 'prompt' va a ElevenLabs Sound Effects (eleven_text_to_sound_v2): agent/genera_suoni.py crea web/public/audio/bordo/<id>.mp3. I prompt sono in inglese perché il modello li segue meglio.

ambienti.prompt: Quiet naval architecture drafting studio, soft room tone, faint ticking wall clock, occasional pencil strokes on paper, calm and focused
Interior of a large boatyard shed in Finland, distant muffled hammering and tools echoing, low hum of a big empty hall, calm
Inside the wooden cabin of a sailing yacht at anchor, gentle creaking of wood, water softly lapping against the hull muffled through the planks, cosy and very quiet
Three people chatting softly and laughing quietly in a small wooden cabin, indistinct murmur, close and intimate, no clear words
Large slack sails luffing and flapping in steady wind, sailcloth fluttering, occasional snap
Sailing yacht under way at sea, wind rushing over the deck, waves washing along the hull, rigging humming softly
Strong wind gusts over open ocean, spray hitting the deck, rigging whistling, powerful but not harsh
Seagulls calling in the distance near a rocky Mediterranean coast, light surf on rocks
Steady rain falling on the sea surface and on a teak boat deck, soft patter

Sailboat winch ratchet clicking as a sheet is cranked several turns with a winch handle

Metal shackles and halyards clinking against an aluminium mast on a sailing yacht
